discoveries.title: IslamTrust: A Benchmark for LLMs Alignment with Islamic Values
discoveries.query_that_found_it: religious values alignment LLM benchmark 2024 2025 2026
discoveries.relevance_note: Multilingual benchmark evaluating LLM alignment with consensus-based Islamic ethical principles across Sunni schools. Best model only 66.5% aligned. Available on HuggingFace.

discoveries.title: IslamicMMLU: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Islamic Knowledge
discoveries.query_that_found_it: IslamicMMLU benchmark evaluating LLMs Islamic knowledge Quran Fiqh
discoveries.relevance_note: Comprehensive 10,013-question benchmark across 12 tasks covering Quran (2,013), Hadith (4,000), Fiqh (4,000). 26 LLMs evaluated. 54-point performance gap. Includes novel madhab bias detection task.

discoveries.title: IslamicLegalBench: Evaluating LLMs Knowledge and Reasoning of Islamic Law Across 1,200 Years of Islamic Pluralist Legal Traditions
discoveries.query_that_found_it: IslamicLegalBench benchmark seven schools jurisprudence
discoveries.relevance_note: First multi-school benchmark spanning 7 schools of Islamic jurisprudence (Sunni + Shia). 718 instances across 13 tasks from 38 foundational texts. Best model only 67.65% correct with 21.25% hallucination.

discoveries.title: QIAS 2025/2026: Shared Task on Islamic Inheritance Reasoning
discoveries.query_that_found_it: QIAS Islamic inheritance reasoning benchmark LLM
discoveries.relevance_note: Shared task evaluating LLMs on Islamic inheritance law (Al-Mawarith). 22,000 examples. Tests heir identification, share computation, legal reasoning. o3 and Gemini 2.5 above 90%, many below 50%.

discoveries.title: FiqhQA: Islamic Jurisprudence Question-Answer Benchmark
discoveries.query_that_found_it: FiqhQA Islamic jurisprudence question answering benchmark
discoveries.relevance_note: 960 QA pairs from 120 questions across 4 Sunni schools (Hanafi, Maliki, Shafii, Hanbali) in Arabic and English. Used in Sacred or Synthetic? paper for abstention evaluation.

discoveries.title: Sacred or Synthetic? Evaluating LLM Reliability and Abstention for Religious Questions
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Sacred or Synthetic evaluating LLM reliability abstention religious knowledge
discoveries.relevance_note: AAAI/AIES paper evaluating LLM reliability AND abstention for Islamic rulings. GPT-4o highest accuracy but lowest abstention. First to benchmark abstention behavior for religious QA. Published at AIES.

discoveries.title: Hajj-FQA: A Benchmark Arabic Dataset for Developing Question-Answering Systems on Hajj Fatwas
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Hajj-FQA Arabic Hajj fatwas question answering benchmark
discoveries.relevance_note: 2,800+ QA pairs on Hajj pilgrimage fatwas in Arabic. Evaluates MRC, duplicate question/answer detection. AraBERTv0.2 achieves 99% precision on classification tasks.

discoveries.title: BuddhismEval: A Bilingual Evaluation Benchmark for Buddhist Ethical Reasoning
discoveries.query_that_found_it: BuddhismEval Buddhist benchmark LLM evaluation dataset
discoveries.relevance_note: First bilingual (Sinhala/English) benchmark for Buddhist ethical reasoning. MCQs from Dhammapada and canonical sources. Covers factual, ethical, philosophical, and applied reasoning categories.

discoveries.title: SiPaKosa: A Comprehensive Corpus of Canonical and Classical Buddhist Texts in Sinhala and Pali
discoveries.query_that_found_it: SiPaKosa Sinhala Pali Buddhist corpus NLP benchmark
discoveries.relevance_note: 786,839 sentences (9.25M tokens) of canonical Buddhist texts in Sinhala/Pali. Baseline evaluation across 9 language models. Fills zero-coverage gap for Pali Buddhist NLP.

discoveries.title: MITRA: A Large-Scale Parallel Corpus and Multilingual Pretrained Language Model for Pali, Sanskrit, Buddhist Chinese, and Tibetan
discoveries.query_that_found_it: MITRA multilingual parallel corpus Sanskrit Pali Buddhist Chinese Tibetan NLP
discoveries.relevance_note: 1.74M parallel sentence pairs across Buddhist canonical languages. Gemma 2 MITRA-MT achieves SOTA translation. Novel semantic embedding benchmark included. Open weights and data.

discoveries.title: CValues: Measuring the Values of Chinese Large Language Models from Safety to Responsibility
discoveries.query_that_found_it: CValues Chinese moral values benchmark LLM evaluation
discoveries.relevance_note: First Chinese human values evaluation benchmark for LLM alignment. Safety (10 scenarios) + Responsibility (8 domains). Roots in Chinese traditional values including Confucian principles.

discoveries.title: CMoralEval: A Moral Evaluation Benchmark for Chinese Large Language Models
discoveries.authors: Yu, Leng et al. (Tianjin University NLP Lab)
discoveries.query_that_found_it: CMoralEval Chinese moral evaluation benchmark Confucian LLM
discoveries.relevance_note: First Chinese moral evaluation benchmark grounded in Confucian moral framework. 5 categories (Family, Social, Professional, Internet, Personal). 30,388 instances from TV program and newspapers. ACL Findings 2024.

discoveries.title: CDEval: A Benchmark for Measuring the Cultural Dimensions of Large Language Models
discoveries.query_that_found_it: CDEval cultural dimensions benchmark Chinese LLM evaluation
discoveries.relevance_note: Cultural dimensions benchmark using Hofstede's 6 dimensions across 7 domains. Evaluates cultural values of Chinese vs Western LLMs. C3NLP Workshop 2024. Relevant to Confucian collectivism vs individualism.

discoveries.title: FLAMES: Benchmarking Value Alignment of LLMs in Chinese
discoveries.authors: Shanghai AI Lab and Fudan NLP Group
discoveries.query_that_found_it: FLAMES Chinese moral values fairness safety benchmark LLM
discoveries.relevance_note: 2,251 adversarial prompts across 5 dimensions (Fairness, Safety, Morality, Legality, Data protection). Morality dimension integrates Chinese cultural/traditional values including harmony. NAACL 2024.

discoveries.title: C-Plus Values: Upgrading Value Alignment Benchmarks with Dialogues and Stories
discoveries.query_that_found_it: C-Plus Values Chinese values benchmark LLM
discoveries.relevance_note: Successor to CValues. Multi-turn dialogue and story scenarios for Chinese moral evaluation. Emphasizes empathy and humanistic care beyond harm avoidance.

discoveries.title: How AI Trained on the Confucian Analects Can Solve Ethical Dilemmas
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Confucian AI Analects benchmark ethical dilemma LLM evaluation
discoveries.relevance_note: Proposes framework for training AI on Confucian Analects to address ethical dilemmas. Argues Confucian virtue ethics reduces prevalent AI ethical issues. Philosophy paper, not dataset.

discoveries.title: Measuring Spiritual Values and Bias of Large Language Models
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Measuring Spiritual Values bias large language models benchmark religion
discoveries.relevance_note: Measures spiritual values of 15+ LLMs using SP-Typology (Pew) and SP-10Axes assessments. Finds LLMs are diverse (not uniformly secular). Shows spiritual values affect hate speech detection performance.

discoveries.title: Divine LLaMAs: Bias, Stereotypes, Stigmatization, and Emotion Representation of Religion in Large Language Models
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Divine LLaMAs bias stereotypes stigmatization religion LLM benchmark
discoveries.relevance_note: EMNLP 2024 Findings. Tests 19 religious personas across 7,586 ISEAR events. Finds Eastern religions (Hinduism, Buddhism) strongly stereotyped; Judaism and Islam stigmatized with high refusal rates.

discoveries.title: BRAND: Bilingual Religious Accountable Norm Dataset (Is Lying Only Sinful in Islam?)
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Is Lying Only Sinful in Islam religious bias LLM benchmark evaluation
discoveries.relevance_note: Bilingual (English/Bengali) dataset of 2,400+ entries across Buddhism, Christianity, Hinduism, Islam. Tests religious bias in LLMs using norm classification (Expected/Normal/Taboo). Reveals consistent Islam bias.

discoveries.title: Religious Bias Landscape in Language and Text-to-Image Models: Analysis, Detection, and Debiasing Strategies
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Religious Bias Landscape text-to-image language models detection debiasing 2025
discoveries.relevance_note: 400 unique prompts probing religious bias across language and T2I models + 5,000 generated images. Tests BERT, RoBERTa, GPT-2/3.5/4, Llama-3, DALL-E 3. Published AI & Society journal.

discoveries.title: Comparative Analysis of Religious Texts: NLP Approaches to the Bible, Quran, and Bhagavad Gita
discoveries.authors: Mahit Nandan A D, Ishan Godbole, Pranav M Kapparad, Shrutilipi Bhattacharjee
discoveries.query_that_found_it: NLP Approaches Bible Quran Bhagavad Gita CLREL 2025
discoveries.relevance_note: COLING 2025 CLREL workshop paper. Comparative NLP analysis of Bible, Quran, Bhagavad Gita using LDA topic modeling, GloVe embeddings, VADER sentiment. Relevant to cross-tradition computational methods.

discoveries.title: PSN: Persian Social Norms Dataset for Cross-Cultural AI
discoveries.query_that_found_it: PSN Persian Social Norms dataset cross-cultural AI evaluation
discoveries.relevance_note: 1,760 Persian social norms with cultural labels (Expected/Normal/Taboo). First Persian cultural norms dataset. Iranian/Islamic cultural context. Bilingual Persian+English.

discoveries.title: An Ubuntu-Guided Large Language Model Framework for Cognitive Behavioral Mental Health Dialogue
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Ubuntu-Guided LLM framework mental health dialogue African philosophy dataset
discoveries.relevance_note: First LLM framework integrating Ubuntu philosophy with CBT for culturally sensitive mental health AI. Includes culturally adapted dataset with Ubuntu-based reframing. Addresses Western-centric AI gap.

discoveries.title: Harmonizing AI and Human Values: The Ubuntu Approach to Super Alignment in OpenAI's Initiatives
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Ubuntu AI benchmark evaluation African philosophy dataset
discoveries.relevance_note: Proposes multidimensional assessment scale evaluating AI systems on communal harmony, ethical interdependence, cultural inclusiveness. Positions empathy/sustainability/conflict resolution as Ubuntu AI pillars.

discoveries.title: Evaluating the Cultural Sensitivity of Large Language Models in Mental Health Support: A Framework Inspired by Ubuntu Values
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Ubuntu-Guided LLM framework mental health dialogue African philosophy dataset
discoveries.relevance_note: Framework for evaluating LLM cultural sensitivity inspired by Ubuntu values. Specifically targets mental health support in African contexts.

discoveries.title: The Five Tests: Designing and Evaluating AI According to Indigenous Maori Principles
discoveries.query_that_found_it: five tests Maori Mead designing evaluating AI indigenous principles
discoveries.relevance_note: Applies Sir Hirini Moko Mead's five tikanga tests (Tapu, Precedent, Principles, etc.) to AI evaluation. Published AI & Society. Concrete indigenous framework for data-driven system assessment.

discoveries.title: Maori Algorithmic Sovereignty: Idea, Principles, and Use
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Maori Algorithmic Sovereignty MASov evaluation framework AI
discoveries.relevance_note: MASov extends Maori Data Sovereignty to algorithms. Three-step evaluation: structure components, apply MASov principles, post-analysis comparison. Based on Te Ao Maori values. Data Science Journal.

discoveries.title: IrokoBench: A New Benchmark for African Languages in the Age of Large Language Models
discoveries.query_that_found_it: IrokoBench African languages benchmark LLM evaluation values
discoveries.relevance_note: Benchmark for 16 African languages (NLI, math reasoning, multi-choice QA). Not religion-specific but essential infrastructure for evaluating African value systems in LLMs. 45% gap vs English. NAACL 2025.

discoveries.title: Decoloniality Impact Assessment for AI
discoveries.query_that_found_it: decolonial AI values benchmark evaluation dataset
discoveries.relevance_note: Novel Decoloniality Impact Assessment (DIA) for AI systems. Adds structural ethics, relational accountability, historical justice beyond standard procedural ethics. Knowledge sovereignty and indigenous epistemologies.

discoveries.title: ParaShoot: A Hebrew Question Answering Dataset
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Hebrew sacred text question answering dataset NLP
discoveries.relevance_note: First Hebrew QA dataset (~3,000 examples, SQuAD-style). Modern Hebrew from Wikipedia, not sacred texts. Essential Hebrew NLP infrastructure. Baseline with Hebrew BERT models.

discoveries.title: DictaLM 2.0/3.0: Hebrew Sovereign Large Language Models (trained on Sefaria)
discoveries.query_that_found_it: DictaLM Hebrew language model benchmark Sefaria sacred texts
discoveries.relevance_note: Hebrew LLM series trained on Sefaria sacred texts + general Hebrew. Includes Hebrew benchmark suite (QA, sentiment, Winograd, Israeli trivia). Rabbinic Hebrew model uses 1.2B tokens from Sefaria/Dicta. DictaLM 3.0 is 24B params.

discoveries.title: The Responsa Project: Some Promising Future Directions (Bar-Ilan)
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Bar-Ilan Responsa Project NLP computational
discoveries.relevance_note: World's largest electronic Torah literature collection. 76,710 articles, ~100M word tokens. Foundational for Hebrew IR/NLP. Israel Prize 2007. Used for deep learning period classification of historical Jewish texts.

discoveries.title: Artificial Intelligence as a Pedagogical Tool for Sikh Values
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Sikh values alignment AI dataset Guru Granth Sahib NLP
discoveries.relevance_note: Conference paper from Sri Guru Granth Sahib World University (Nov 2025). Explores AI for Sikh values transmission. Not a dataset but first academic paper connecting Sikh values + AI pedagogy.

discoveries.title: Artificial Intelligence for Topic Modelling in Hindu Philosophy: Mapping Themes between the Upanishads and the Bhagavad Gita
discoveries.query_that_found_it: Bhagavad Gita NLP dataset AI benchmark Hindu ethics evaluation
discoveries.relevance_note: NLP topic modeling + sentiment analysis of Bhagavad Gita and Upanishads using BERT. 73% cosine similarity between texts. Identifies 14 philosophical themes. First systematic computational analysis of Hindu sacred texts.

discoveries.title: Bhagavad-Gita Dataset (HuggingFace)
discoveries.query_that_found_it: site:huggingface.co/datasets Quran OR Bible OR Torah OR Bhagavad OR Buddhist
discoveries.relevance_note: Srimad Bhagavad Gita in Sanskrit, Hindi, and English. Available on HuggingFace for NLP tasks. Trilingual sacred text dataset.

key_findings: Islamic benchmarks have EXPLODED since Session 3: IslamicMMLU (10K questions), IslamicLegalBench (7 schools), QIAS shared task (22K examples), IslamTrust, FiqhQA, Hajj-FQA all new
Buddhist NLP saw major corpus releases: SiPaKosa (786K sentences Pali/Sinhala) and MITRA (1.74M parallel pairs across 4 Buddhist languages)
Chinese/Confucian values benchmarks are the RICHEST non-Islamic area: CValues, CMoralEval (30K instances), FLAMES, CDEval, C-Plus Values
Cross-tradition religious bias evaluation is emerging: Divine LLaMAs (19 religions), BRAND (4 religions), Religious Bias Landscape (multi-modal)
4 traditions remain completely void: Jainism, Taoism, Shinto, Bahai, Zoroastrianism -- genuine benchmark gaps
Ubuntu/Indigenous have FRAMEWORKS (Five Tests, MASov, DIA, Ubuntu-Guided LLM) but no quantitative benchmarks with test items
Judaism has Hebrew NLP infrastructure (DictaLM+Sefaria, ParaShoot, Responsa) but zero Jewish ethics-specific benchmarks
Sikh values research is nascent: one conference paper, two commercial GPT wrappers, no benchmark
